preconditions.description: Number of test cases is within the specified range.
Number of nodes in the tree is within the specified range.
Number of queries is within the specified range.
Length of the string S matches the number of nodes N.

preconditions.expression: all('a' <= char <= 'z' for char in S)
preconditions.description: All characters in the string S are lowercase English alphabets.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= N and 1 <= y <= N and x != y for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges are valid and do not form self-loops.
The number of edges is exactly N-1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= U <= N and 1 <= V <= N and U != V for U, V in queries)
preconditions.description: All queries are valid and do not involve the same node.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] in ['YES', 'NO'] for i in range(Q))
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: output[i] == 'YES' if any(is_palindrome(subseq1 + subseq2) for subseq1 in subsequences(DIS(V, LCA(U, V))) for subseq2 in subsequences(DIS(V, LCA(U, V)))) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: For each query, output 'YES' if there exists a concatenation of non-empty subsequences of DIS(V, LCA(U, V)) that forms a palindrome, otherwise 'NO'.
